description: Install a theme from a public ZIP URL (must end in .zip). Unlike mcp_install_plugin_zip there is no GitHub token support: private release assets cannot be installed this way.

activate.description: Switch to the theme after install (default false)

overwrite.description: Replace the theme folder if it already exists (default true; the active theme is never overwritten)

url.description: URL to the theme ZIP file (must end in .zip)

name: mcp_install_theme_zip
